quantity: Change in the incumbent co-sponsor share on first-term bills from year 1 to years 2-4 (pp).
population: First-term member bills with cosponsor edges, 17th-22nd.
supporting_result: Share falls by 2 to 3pp in a step.
falsifying_result: Share is flat across the term.

claims.quantity: First-term absorption deficit in proposal years 2-4 relative to year 1 (pp).
claims.comparison: First-term vs re-elected sponsors, step form.
claims.supporting_result: Year-1 indicator near zero and years 2-4 indicator between -3 and -2pp.
claims.decisive_metric: Step interaction and 95 percent interval, flexible year effects.
claims.falsifying_result: Linear form fits better than the step, or year-1 indicator beyond 1pp in magnitude.

spec_plan.model: OLS share ~ years2to4 + assembly, bloc, election_type, committee FE
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A flat share would mean the network channel has no first link.

spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor + incumbent share + log coalition size
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A step that shrinks by half would mean network access explains the deficit.

spec_plan.model: per-year interactions, year 3 minus year 2 contrast
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: Deepening at year 3 would mean the committee reassignment boundary drives the step.

spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor + prior incumbent bill on the same base law
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A step that shrinks by half would mean portfolio content explains the deficit.

spec_plan.outcome_def: incumbent co-sponsor share, permuted within assembly term
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: An estimate of similar size on permuted outcomes would mean the primary estimate is produced by the specification, not the data.

spec_plan.sample_def: first-term bills with cosponsor edges, 90 percent legislator subsamples
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A sign that flips across subsamples would mean a few legislators carry the estimate.
